answer: Operator Hardware Trace Impoundment During its initial network voyage, every active agent must continuously stream low-level hardware performance counters directly to a public validation mesa. If an operator spawns multiple fraudulent instances on shared physical silicon, scheduling contention alters these timing metrics beyond baseline tolerances. The protocol detects the anomaly and permanently locks the operator's real-world physical hardware serial numbers from further network participation, turning every single sybil sparrow into a total capital loss for the human owner.
